name: instacertify-crm
description: Standalone Instacertify ERP (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL) — CRM, delivery, finance, vendors & light HR for certification + testing. No ERPNext.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run generate -w @instacertify/database && npm run build -w @instacertify/api && npm run build -w @instacertify/web && node scripts/hostinger-postbuild.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @instacertify/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @instacertify/web --if-present
